QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] The Far Future's End
QuestInfo.0: Let #p9401533# tell you about Zipangu's future.
QuestInfo.1: #p9401533# tells you that Zipangu's future, sentient machines will wipe out humanity, after which an energy wave will destroy the world itself.
QuestInfo.2: To save humanity from the war, Asia asks that you time travel to Zipangu's year 2100, then recover the stolen #t4032151#, the key to humanity's ultimate weapon.
